sn45.165:1.1: imā bhikkhave dukkhatā || katamā tisso || || Dukkhadukkhatā saṅkhāradukkhatā vipariṇāmadukkhatā || imā kho bhikkhave tisso dukkhatā || || Imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave tissannam dukkhatānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya || la || ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || || [2--33]
